title: Asanisuttaṃ
text:
162 . Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati…pe… ‘‘dāruṇo, bhikkhave, lābhasakkārasiloko…pe… adhigamāya. Kaṃ, bhikkhave, asanivicakkaṃ āgacchatu , sekhaṃ appattamānasaṃ lābhasakkārasiloko anupāpuṇātu’’ .
‘‘Asanivicakkanti kho, bhikkhave, lābhasakkārasilokassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ. Evaṃ dāruṇo kho, bhikkhave, lābhasakkārasiloko…pe… evañhi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabba’’nti. Chaṭṭhaṃ.
